hero.title: A holistic approach to dyscalculia
hero.subtitle: Two scientific apps spanning diagnosis to intervention: assess children's numerical abilities, map developmental areas, and support growth through gamified learning.

workflow.title: A holistic three-step process
workflow.subtitle: Begin with scientific diagnosis, continue with personalized intervention, complete with progress monitoring.
workflow.step1_desc: Scientifically assess the numerical abilities of children from preschool through 4th grade (48–119 months / ages 4–10) with Numap's A1–A11 test battery.
workflow.step2_desc: Support areas identified during diagnosis with Galaksay's 59+ gamified learning modules.
workflow.step3_desc: Track development closely with performance data, psychometric analyses, and clinical reports.

apps.title: Two complementary scientific tools
apps.subtitle: Numap manages the diagnostic process; Galaksay is the gamified heart of learning. Together they support children's numerical development end to end.

numap_card.title: Numap
numap_card.desc: A clinical platform that scientifically screens, assesses, and reports dyscalculia risk in children from preschool through 4th grade (48–119 months / ages 4–10). A1–A11 diagnostic and B1–B9 intervention batteries, millisecond-precision reaction time, psychometric indices (d-prime, Flanker, IES) and automated clinical reporting.

galaksay_card.title: Galaksay
galaksay_card.desc: "Numbers are the language of the universe" — a space adventure that turns into a number-learning universe. For children aged 3–8, 59+ gamified modules, the DokunSay pedagogical framework, adaptive difficulty, and triple coding (concrete–pictorial–symbolic) build numerical thinking.

numap_detail.title: Numap
numap_detail.subtitle: A comprehensive clinical platform for the scientific assessment of numerical abilities. Dyscalculia screening and intervention tracking.
numap_detail.features_subtitle: Features designed with scientific rigor and optimized for practical use.
numap_detail.f1_desc: End-to-end assessment and training process via A1–A11 diagnostic and B1–B9 intervention batteries.
numap_detail.f2_desc: Millisecond-level reaction time measurement with fallback mechanisms for detection reliability.
numap_detail.f3_desc: Automatic computation of scientific indices such as d-prime, Flanker effect, and IES (Inverse Efficiency Score).
numap_detail.f4_desc: Automatic risk labels (HR/R/M/N/S/HS) via norm tables for age groups from preschool through 4th grade (48–119 months / ages 4–10).
numap_detail.f5_desc: Excel exports including item analysis, summary statistics, and recommendations; optional AI-assisted interpretation.
numap_detail.f6_desc: Offline operation via Service Worker, background sync, PWA installation on tablets.
numap_detail.f7_desc: Official Android version on Google Play; fully synced with the web via TWA.
numap_detail.f8_desc: Institution-based RBAC filtering, license/subscription management, practitioner dashboard.
numap_detail.tests_subtitle: Grounded in international literature, normed for the Turkish sample.
numap_detail.launch_subtitle: The app opens embedded within the portal. Log in with your own account to continue your work.
numap_detail.embed_note: If the app cannot load embedded, open it in a new tab.

galaksay_detail.title: Galaksay
galaksay_detail.subtitle: Numbers are the language of the universe. A space-themed, gamified number-learning universe for children aged 3–8.
galaksay_detail.features_subtitle: A rich learning experience combining pedagogical rigor with fun.
galaksay_detail.f1_desc: Counting, subitizing, comparison, part–whole, place value, addition–subtraction, multiplication–division, patterns.
galaksay_detail.f2_desc: Concrete (chips/tokens) → pictorial (bar models, number frames) → symbolic triple-coding approach.
galaksay_detail.f3_desc: Performance logging, frustration detection, personalized 5-level hint system.
galaksay_detail.f4_desc: Learning Trajectory levels 2–18 with LT-aware module sequencing.
galaksay_detail.f5_desc: Turkish, English, and Kurdish support with Web TTS narration.
galaksay_detail.f6_desc: XP, streak rewards, badges, story-based progression; Montessori color palette.
galaksay_detail.f7_desc: Personalized routing that considers Numap results through risk-based profiling.
galaksay_detail.f8_desc: Data-visualization panels showing the child's progress and strengths/weaknesses.
galaksay_detail.modules_subtitle: A selection from 59+ modules — representative of scope.
galaksay_detail.launch_subtitle: The app opens embedded within the portal. Ready for the space adventure?
galaksay_detail.embed_note: If the app cannot load embedded, open it in a new tab.

about.title: Diskalkuli Platform
about.subtitle: A science-based solution from Turkey for dyscalculia screening, assessment, and intervention.
about.mission_text: To ensure that number-learning difficulties in children in Turkey and worldwide are detected early through scientific methods and supported with gamified, pedagogically sound interventions.
about.vision_text: To build a learning ecosystem where every child can reach their mathematical potential, empowering teachers, parents, and clinicians with scientific data.
about.profile_bio: Academic in mathematics education, dyscalculia, and specific learning difficulties. Scientific architect of Numap's diagnostic batteries and Galaksay's learning trajectories. Leads extensive research on dyscalculia awareness and early intervention processes in Turkey.
about.v1_desc: Every design decision is rooted in international literature and the Turkish sample.
about.v2_desc: Solutions every teacher can reach — multi-language, offline, mobile/tablet friendly.
about.v3_desc: An uninterrupted digital ecosystem from diagnosis to intervention and monitoring.
about.v4_desc: Fun, reassuring, and pressure-free learning experiences.
